articles.title: Raipur Scandal: Storyteller Bhaskaracharya Caught With Married Woman in Car, Beaten by Mob
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Raipur, Chhattisgarh – A shocking scandal from the capital city has taken social media by storm after a video surfaced showing renowned storyteller Bhaskaracharya being thrashed by locals for allegedly being caught in a compromising position with a married woman inside a car.

body.html:
Raipur, Chhattisgarh – A shocking scandal from the capital city has taken social media by storm after a video surfaced showing renowned storyteller Bhaskaracharya being thrashed by locals for allegedly being caught in a compromising position with a married woman inside a car.

According to reports, Bhaskaracharya, a well-known kathavachak from Rewa, Madhya Pradesh, had travelled to Raipur to meet his alleged lover — the wife of a local resident, Anil Gupta. The woman, reportedly a mother of an 18-year-old son, was found with the storyteller inside a parked car when her husband, who had been suspicious for some time, caught them red-handed.

Eyewitnesses say that an enraged Gupta and several bystanders dragged Bhaskaracharya out of the car and beat him brutally. The viral footage shows the storyteller being assaulted, with unconfirmed reports claiming that he sustained severe injuries during the attack.

Following the incident, the woman’s husband lodged a complaint at the local police station and submitted a written statement declaring that his wife could live with Bhaskaracharya if she chose to do so. Meanwhile, police have launched an investigation into the assault and the circulation of the video on social media.

The case has become a major topic of debate across Chhattisgarh, with the viral video sparking discussions about morality, infidelity, and public violence.

articles.title: Viral ‘Drunk Man Petting Tiger in Pench’ Video Exposed as AI-Generated Fake
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh – A bizarre video claiming to show a man named Raju Patel from Pench Tiger Reserve petting and offering alcohol to a tiger has gone viral on social media — but fact-checkers have confirmed the clip is completely fake and AI-generated.

body.html:
Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh – A bizarre video claiming to show a man named Raju Patel from Pench Tiger Reserve petting and offering alcohol to a tiger has gone viral on social media — but fact-checkers have confirmed the clip is completely fake and AI-generated.

The viral post alleged that 52-year-old Raju, a labourer, mistook a tiger for a “big cat” after a late-night drinking session and tried to pet it under streetlights. The video, styled like CCTV footage, appeared so realistic that many users believed it was an actual incident from Pench.

However, no credible local media outlet or the forest department has reported any such event. Investigations by fact-checkers revealed that the footage was created using artificial intelligence and was being circulated online purely for entertainment.

Authorities have urged people not to believe or share unverified videos online, warning that AI-generated misinformation can cause unnecessary panic and confusion.

articles.title: Ex-Youth Congress Leader Aditya Arrested for Sexual Harassment, Locals Thrash Him Before Police Arr
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case has emerged from Chikkamagaluru, where former Youth Congress Vice President Aditya was arrested on charges of sexually harassing multiple women and circulating their edited photos online.

body.html:
A shocking case has emerged from Chikkamagaluru, where former Youth Congress Vice President Aditya was arrested on charges of sexually harassing multiple women and circulating their edited photos online. The incident has triggered public outrage, with videos of locals assaulting the accused going viral across social media.

According to police, Aditya, who earlier served as the Youth Congress Vice President of Aldur Hobli, allegedly befriended several women—including wives of his acquaintances—through phone conversations before harassing them. A complaint lodged by a woman from Jayanagar stated that Aditya sexually harassed her multiple times and later spread morphed versions of her social media photos when she resisted. The victim also alleged that he threatened to kill her if she exposed him.

Soon after the complaint surfaced, a group of enraged locals—both men and women—stormed Aditya’s residence in Adishakti Nagar and brutally assaulted him. The mob attack, captured on video, has sparked widespread debate over vigilantism and “public justice.” Despite the viral footage, no formal case has yet been registered regarding the assault.

Chikkamagaluru Police have filed a case (Crime No. 182/25) against Aditya under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita Sections 75(2) and 78, the IT Act Sections 67 and 67(A), and Section 4 of the Indecent Representation of Women (Prohibition) Act.

Officials confirmed that multiple women may be victims, and further investigation is underway to determine the extent of the harassment and the digital evidence involved.

articles.title: Speeding Car Crashes Head-On Into Bus While Overtaking on Curve — Driver Miraculously Survives
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Malappuram, Kerala – A shocking CCTV video from Edappal town in Kerala’s Malappuram district has gone viral, capturing a horrifying road accident involving a Toyota Etios Liva and a private bus. The incident occurred around 6:20 am on Wednesday, October 29.

body.html:
Malappuram, Kerala – A shocking CCTV video from Edappal town in Kerala’s Malappuram district has gone viral, capturing a horrifying road accident involving a Toyota Etios Liva and a private bus. The incident occurred around 6:20 am on Wednesday, October 29.

According to reports, the car, driven by a youth from Muvattupuzha in Ernakulam district, was attempting to overtake a lorry on a curved stretch of road marked with solid lines — a clear no-overtaking zone. As the driver tried to pass, a bus appeared from the opposite direction. Despite braking at the last moment, the car failed to swerve back into its lane and crashed head-on into the bus.

The impact was severe — the car’s front was completely crushed, its roof caved in, and one of the rear wheels broke off. Smoke was seen billowing from the engine moments after the crash, though no fire broke out.

CCTV footage shows locals and the bus driver rushing to the mangled car to rescue the trapped driver. The bystanders managed to pull him out, and he was taken to a nearby hospital. Miraculously, he escaped with only minor injuries.

Police and eyewitnesses confirmed that reckless overtaking on a blind curve caused the accident. The driver’s impatience, despite visible double solid lines, nearly cost him his life.

Authorities have once again urged motorists to follow lane discipline and avoid overtaking in restricted zones, stressing that even a moment’s negligence can lead to disaster.

articles.title: UP Doctor’s Explosive Claim on Fake Encounters Sparks Uproar — Later Calls His Own Video ‘Fake
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Shamli, Uttar Pradesh – A senior government doctor’s startling allegations against the police have triggered widespread controversy and confusion in the district. Dr.

body.html:
Shamli, Uttar Pradesh – A senior government doctor’s startling allegations against the police have triggered widespread controversy and confusion in the district.

Dr. Deepak Kumar, Chief Medical Superintendent (CMS) at a local health facility, was seen in a viral video accusing Shamli Police of fabricating encounter reports. He alleged that officers pressured medical staff to under-report bullet injuries during post-mortem examinations, claiming that bodies riddled with up to 20 bullets were officially recorded as having just one gunshot wound.

The doctor’s remarks surfaced during a protest over a theft incident at his office, where he criticised police inaction. During the heated demonstration, Dr. Kumar made the serious claims, which were captured on camera and circulated rapidly across social media platforms.

Following the uproar, Shamli Police issued a strong denial, asserting that Dr. Kumar had not been part of any post-mortem panels related to police encounters in 2025. The police termed his allegations “factually baseless” and aimed at creating unnecessary panic.

As the video continued to spread, Dr. Kumar later released another statement, calling the earlier clip “fake” and claiming it was recorded without his consent. He attributed his comments to poor health and mental stress, saying he is undergoing treatment for liver, heart, and psychological issues.

Dr. Kumar clarified that he was not involved in any encounter-related post-mortems this year and requested that his earlier remarks not be taken seriously.

The police have dismissed the allegations as unfounded, reaffirming that no medical panels for encounter cases included Dr. Kumar in 2025. Meanwhile, an inquiry into the viral video and the surrounding controversy is underway.

articles.title: Woman Accuses Rapido Auto Driver of Harassment After Ride Cancellation Dispute — Driver Suspended
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video from Bengaluru has gone viral showing a heated argument between a woman and a Rapido auto driver, after which the woman accused the driver of harassing and threatening her over a ride cancellation dispute.

body.html:
A video from Bengaluru has gone viral showing a heated argument between a woman and a Rapido auto driver, after which the woman accused the driver of harassing and threatening her over a ride cancellation dispute.

According to the woman, she asked the driver to wait for two minutes outside her home as she was searching for her keys. When she arrived, the driver allegedly demanded extra waiting charges, claiming he had been waiting for 10 minutes.

When the woman refused to pay and asked him to cancel the ride, the driver reportedly lost his temper, refused to cancel the trip, and verbally harassed her, saying —

“Aap kaise jaoge main bhi dekhta huun.”

The woman recorded the confrontation on video, which has since gone viral on social media. She later revealed that she paid ₹20 extra to avoid further escalation.

Following public outrage, Rapido officials immediately suspended the driver and reached out to the woman for support. She confirmed on X, saying:

“@rapidobikeapp team reached out and reviewed the matter. The captain is suspended. They were quick to help with this.”

The Bengaluru City Police also responded under the viral post, requesting her to share details via DM for further action.

While police have not yet confirmed any legal proceedings, the video has triggered divided reactions online — with some supporting the woman’s stand and others debating driver accountability.

articles.title: Shocking in UP’s Mirzapur: Ambulance Driver Drops Pregnant Woman on Muddy Road
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a deeply distressing incident from Mirzapur district, Uttar Pradesh, a pregnant woman was forced to give birth on a dirt road after the ambulance driver refused to drive through a muddy stretch leading to a government-run primary health centre.

body.html:
In a deeply distressing incident from Mirzapur district, Uttar Pradesh, a pregnant woman was forced to give birth on a dirt road after the ambulance driver refused to drive through a muddy stretch leading to a government-run primary health centre.

According to reports, the woman — wife of Atiq Ahmad — was being rushed to the hospital when the ambulance driver stopped midway, citing the road condition. Despite the family pleading for help, he allegedly dropped them on the roadside and left.

Moments later, the woman went into labour and delivered the baby on the muddy road, as bystanders tried to assist in the delivery.

Atiq Ahmad later recounted that the ambulance arrived late even after multiple calls for emergency assistance, and no medical staff were present at the time of delivery.

The incident has sparked outrage, with Mirzapur District Magistrate ordering an inquiry into the matter and calling it an “unfortunate and unacceptable failure.”
